Author: Spaceghost
Name: Ghostty
Punchline: A Ghostty terminal inside the game.
Description: A terminal emulator with dropdown, floating and world-pinned views. Use /term to toggle. Linux/Wine requires a separately started ghostty-agent and token configuration. Native Windows requires selecting a ConPTY profile. Shells run with your user permissions; only run commands and Lua configuration you trust. Umbra integration is optional and installed separately. This is an experimental build, not an approved mainline release.
